game.name: ASHVALE
game.description: New in 0.8.128: four Fortune Engines in the Saltmere Tap's card room upstairs, steel cabinets with mechanical reels made by a master smith and a wizard. Sit on the bench, put GOLD in the coin slot, pick a wager from 1 to 300 and pull the lever; the @ashvale Bank keeps your credit and sends it home when you stand up. From 0.8.127, by sadfrogltc: the Heart Below dungeon is rebuilt and the dragon fight reworked, three quests are back, and Cinder's deer are home north of the wall. From 0.8.126: chess moves show in the chat. From 0.8.124: a table played for GOLD asks before you sit. From 0.8.123: your @handle is your name, everywhere. Ziibiing's land is there the moment you arrive. And from 0.8.120: each home has its own chest. What you put in a Ziibiing chest stays in Ziibiing's chests, what you put in an Ashvale chest stays in Ashvale's, and anything new from the arcade shows in both until you take it. Gold still on its way from the Bank counts in your chest at once. Chess pieces no longer jump back after a move, the card table shows all five board cards in a row, and ASHVALE has its own tab icon. ASHVALE is free to play: knights, wizards and archers, the Saltmere Tap's card room upstairs, the Chess Park, and the Ojibwe village of Ziibiing on the far continent.
